title: Dr. Trayaurus and Tray's Mom
description: Brings back Dr. Trayaurus from DanTDM series as well as his mom
body:
This resource pack brings back Dr. Trayaurus back in the form of a renamed Wandering Trader as well as adding Tray's mom in the form of a renamed Witch

**REQUIRES [Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) or Optifine**

To get Trayaurus, rename Wandering Trader as "Dr Trayaurus" or "Dr. Trayaurus" or "Trayaurus" (Not case sensitive)

To get Tray's Mom, rename a Witch as "Tray's Mom" or "Trays Mom" (Not case sensitive either)
